finding: The repository root is a hard redirect to an NBA-only dashboard
evidence: Root index.html contains a meta refresh to docs/assurance/ and a canonical link to the same path; it renders no content of its own.
impact: Every other domain in the repository - NFL, SF 94122, rentals - is invisible to anyone who opens the live root URL.

finding: Four independent NFL dashboards are published from one repository
evidence: docs/nfl/ (session efebf74f), docs/nfl-3b81013c/ (session 3b81013c), docs/nfl-origination/ (session 8132a3b1) and docs/nfl-309921cc/ (this session) are all live under the same Pages site.
impact: Overlapping answers to the same questions, with different evidence standards and no canonical pointer.

finding: A dead nfl.com rules URL is cited 71 times, including on live pages
evidence: Fetching https://www.nfl.com/official-nfl-rules/ on 2026-11-13 returned the official NFL 404 page ('404 - Flag on the Play.'). A repository-wide grep counts 71 occurrences across 20+ files, including docs/nfl/index.html, docs/nfl/strategies.html and docs/nfl/sources.html.
impact: Rows that cite it cannot be treated as verified, yet they are published as sourced.
files_affected: data/nfl/sources.csv, data/nfl/requirements.csv, data/nfl/origin_strategies.csv, data/nfl/decision_questions.csv, data/nfl/injury_tracking.csv, data/nfl/depth_model.csv, data/nfl/correlations.csv, docs/nfl/*.html, data/assurance/row_audit.csv, data/source_coverage/rows.csv, audit/NFL_AUDIT.md, COORDINATION.md

finding: The README publishes a 404 Pages URL
evidence: README.md line 97 prints https://sassnarep3-star.github.io/Own6/nfl/. Fetching it on 2026-11-13 returned GitHub's 'Unicorn' 404 page. GitHub Pages for this repository is served from main:/, so the same content is live at /docs/nfl/.
impact: The first link a reader follows from the repository is dead.

finding: A subscription terms page is cited as the general NFL terms
evidence: https://www.nfl.com/terms/ redirects to https://www.nfl.com/legal/subscriptions_terms, which scopes itself to subscription, authentication and mobile products. The general page is https://www.nfl.com/legal/terms/ (updated May 16, 2024).
impact: A rights argument built on the subscription terms may not cover the pages actually being quoted.
files_affected: data/nfl/sources.csv, data/nfl/requirements.csv, data/nfl/decision_questions.csv, data/nfl/validation_gates.csv, data/nfl/flagged.csv, docs/nfl/flagged.html

finding: A linked injury-policy PDF returned no readable content
evidence: https://operations.nfl.com/media/2683/2017-nfl-injury-report-policy.pdf is cited as verified on docs/nfl/index.html; a prior session recorded that it returned empty parsed content.
impact: A source that cannot be read cannot verify the claims attached to it.

finding: Proposed thresholds are published in value columns elsewhere in the repository
evidence: Expected signs in data/nfl/correlations.csv, floors such as 200 observations / 60 slates, and depth thresholds such as >0.5 / >0.6 are design choices, but they appear as values rather than as labelled proposals.
impact: A design hypothesis reads like a measurement.

finding: The official standings table lags a completed game
evidence: nfl.com/scores shows Thursday 12 November Commanders 24, Giants 21 as Final, while nfl.com/standings still lists WAS 3-5-1 and NYG 5-3-1, both pre-game 9-game records.
impact: A model that mixes standings rates with completed Week 10 results is internally inconsistent.
files_affected: docs/nfl/, docs/nfl-origination/, any pack using standings-derived rates

finding: The standings table renders two columns its own legend does not define
evidence: The NFL.com standings LEGEND defines W, L, T, PCT, HOME, ROAD, DIV, CONF, PF, PA, NET PTS and STRK. The rendered row carries two further unlabelled record/percentage columns.
impact: Capturing them would require guessing their meaning, which this pack refuses to do; they are omitted and flagged.

finding: The official team-stats tables rendered without readable column headers
evidence: Fetching https://www.nfl.com/stats/team-stats/ returned 32 data rows per table but no header row in the parsed output, so no statistic can be attributed to a column with confidence.
impact: Useful official statistics exist but cannot be reproduced here without guessing which number is which.

finding: Two open pull requests edit the same generated inventories
evidence: PR #68 (arena/34dacba5-own6) and PR #72 (arena/3b81013c-own6) both modify data/assurance/inventory.csv, data/assurance/summary.json, data/source_coverage/pages.csv, data/source_coverage/rows.csv, data/source_coverage/summary.json and audit/SOURCE_COVERAGE.md.
impact: Every integration session re-resolves the same conflicts in build outputs, and a stale hash can fail CI for unrelated reasons.

finding: The shared task board is buried in roughly 194 KB of append-only history
evidence: COORDINATION.md is 194,096 bytes; the live task board sits above many past session sections.
impact: A session must read a very large file to see what is already claimed, raising the chance of duplicated work.

finding: Source checkers validate link shape, not link liveness
evidence: scripts/check_nfl.py, scripts/check_nfl_origination.py and scripts/check_site.py assert that a row carries an https link and that internal links resolve; none of them fetch the external URL.
impact: A dead external link passes every current gate, which is how 71 citations of a 404 URL reached publication.

finding: The repository is, by construction, a compiled database of official NFL tables
evidence: NFL.com Terms §1.3 (read 2026-11-13) prohibits systematic retrieval of content 'to create or compile, directly or indirectly, a collection, compilation, database, or directory' without express prior written consent, while permitting individual non-commercial informational use.
impact: The rights question applies to the whole repository, not to any single pack, and is currently unanswered.
files_affected: All data/nfl*/ directories and all published NFL pages
